prompt: How many jersey numbers had the Houston Astros officially retired in the 21st century before the retirement of Billy Wagner's No. 13?
answer: **Three** jersey numbers—Larry Dierker’s No. 49 (2002), Jimmy Wynn’s No. 24 (2005), and Craig Biggio’s No. 7 (2008)—had been retired in the 21st century before Billy Wagner’s No. 13 was retired in 2025.
